description: Bellos, Vasilis at Democritus University of Thrace publishes 53 experimental datasets on the storage of urban floodwater inside buildings through Co-UDlabs. The experiments vary rainfall, roofs, open doors and basements. Components include sensor-voltage records, setup/scenario metadata, calibration measurements and converted CSV series with uncertainty bounds; the layout documents house and sensor positions. Coverage is a laboratory urban-flood physical model; scenario-specific start times and sampling rates are stored in file headers. Zenodo provides 7 z and ZIP archives, layout PDF and text scenario legends with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the 53 component sets are a single experiment collection, and idealised buildings do not establish storage performance in an actual city. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
